title: Rock of Ages
description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

title: Jack Reacher
description: A defense attorney hires an enigmatic ex-Army investigator to tackle the case of a highly trained sniper who apparently murdered five people at random.

title: MobLand
description:
S02 E06 — A Different Corner
Licking wounds and turning on each other after fleeing Frankie's assault, Seraphina goes all in, pitching the Harrigans on a global power play; Maeve and Harry square off over crossed lines.

title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
description: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) goes on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers.

title: Crimes of the Future
description: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs.

title: Kiss the Girls
description: After escaping from a serial killer, a doctor (Ashley Judd) helps police and a forensic psychologist (Morgan Freeman) track the madman.

title: Patriot Games
description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
description: A woman (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) discovers the horrifying truth about the outside world while living in an underground shelter with two men (John Goodman, John Gallagher Jr.).

title: True Grit
description: A teenage girl (Hailee Steinfeld) enlists the aid of a boozy, trigger-happy lawman (Jeff Bridges) to hunt down her father's killer (Josh Brolin).

title: Hotel Transylvania 2
description: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula and his friends put the boy through a "monster-in-training" boot camp just as Drac's old-school father decides to pay a visit.

title: Scary Movie V
description: Bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn baby home from the hospital. Realizing that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal experts and install numerous cameras to drive the spirit out.

title: Vicious
description: A strange ritual soon unravels into a waking nightmare when a woman receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love.

title: The Dutchman
description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway.

title: Sleeping Dogs
description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

title: Noah
description: God chooses Noah (Russell Crowe) to build an ark and save the animals and his family from an apocalyptic flood.
Sparta's King Leonidas (Gerard Butler) and his badly outnumbered warriors fight to the death against King Xerxes' massive Persian army at the Battle of Thermopylae.

title: Troy
description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.

title: The Equalizer 2
description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

title: Gangs of New York
description: During the era of Tammany Hall's sway, a young man (Leonardo DiCaprio) vows vengeance on the vicious gangster (Daniel Day-Lewis) who killed his father.

title: Sleeping Dogs
description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

title: A Simple Plan
description: A Minnesotan (Bill Paxton), his dimwitted brother (Billy Bob Thornton) and his brother's redneck friend (Brent Briscoe) find and decide to keep $4 million.

title: The Score
description: A master thief (Robert De Niro) agrees to work with a volatile partner (Edward Norton) for one last heist before he retires.

title: The Saint
description: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

title: You've Got Mail
description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

title: Forrest Gump
description: JFK, LBJ, Vietnam, Watergate and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man (Tom Hanks) with an IQ of 75.

title: Apocalypse Now Redux
description: An Army agent (Martin Sheen) goes upriver into the heart of Cambodia to kill a renegade colonel (Marlon Brando).

title: Total Recall
description: Recurring nightmares of the planet Mars lead a confused earthling into the center of an intergalactic conspiracy.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
description: Two cyborgs from the future battle over the life of a teen (Edward Furlong) who will someday lead humanity against the machines.

title: Molly's Game
description: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

title: Hotel Transylvania
description: Dracula becomes overprotective when a human boy discovers his monsters-only resort during a birthday celebration and falls for his teenage daughter.

title: Beastly
description: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love.

title: Walking Out
description: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear.

title: Brave the Dark
description: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart.

title: Dunkirk
description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

title: I Was a Stranger
description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

title: Se7en
description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

title: Side Effects
description: A woman's (Rooney Mara) world unravels after her psychiatrist (Jude Law) prescribes a new medication to treat her anxiety.

title: Magic Mike
description: A male stripper takes a newcomer under his wing and instructs him in the fine arts of partying, picking up women and making plenty of money.

title: Magic Mike XXL
description: Three years after retiring from stripping, Mike Lane (Channing Tatum) reunites with the rest of the Kings of Tampa (Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello) for one final, outrageous performance in Myrtle Beach, S.C.

title: Gone Baby Gone
description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child.

title: Scream 2
description: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college.

title: King Kong
description: An oil explorer (Charles Grodin), a zoologist (Jeff Bridges) and a shipwrecked blonde (Jessica Lange) capture a huge ape leading to a battle atop the World Trade Center.
